text:
Maya (People Ops): heads-up: rolling out a compact handbook change next Tue noon PT - 'Hybrid travel & home-office stipend'. Key bits: cap adjustments, eligibility clarifications for part-time and contractors, and a short manager checklist. Please flag anything that blocks publishing. :mega:

Leo (Payroll): Will this require any mid-month adjustments? I need to know if payroll mapping changes for May runs.

Maya (People Ops): No mid-month changes planned. New stipend caps apply starting the first pay period in May. We'll provide a CSV mapping and change-log.

Ana (Legal): For EU & UK, add a liability note and link to local legal addenda. Contractors need separate language. I'll drop the clause into the doc by EOD.

Priya (EMEA Ops): Confirm - contractors in some countries can't receive stipends the same way. We'll need a callout and contact pointer. Also translations will take ~4 business days.

Carlos (Comp): I'll publish the country-by-country stipend table tomorrow. It will include gross vs net notes and whether stipend is taxable.

Maya (People Ops): Plan: publish the global master update (clearly labelled) + region-specific addenda as they land. Micro-cert required for all full-time employees; contractors get a notice to review their contract link. Manager checklist (quick 8 bullets) due within 2 weeks of publish.

manager-bot: Reminder scheduled: managers will get an automated DM on publish + follow-up nudges at day 3 & day 10.

Leo (Payroll): Requesting CSV format for import. Suggested headers below. Please include ack_version so we can filter historical acks.

```
# stipend_export.csv header
employee_id,full_name,email,region,employment_type,stipend_amount,paid_via,ack_version,ack_ts
```

Maya (People Ops): good header. Also include a column `notes` for manager overrides.

Carlos (Comp): added. Also: reimbursements still require receipts; stipends do not. We'll add a short FAQ section.

Ana (Legal): added contractor pointer: "Contractors: refer to contract or contact ops@redwood.com". Legal sign-off recorded.

Priya (EMEA Ops): Can we include an opt-in checkbox for office-desk reimbursement vs stipend? Some local teams prefer desk procurement.

Maya (People Ops): yes — we'll add a short flow and decision tree. Sophie (we didn't call), but assign to product ops to make the small flow in Confluence.

Leo (Payroll): I'll confirm import mapping by Friday. If comp table lands tomorrow I'll validate country tax flags.

Carlos (Comp): sending the table in the morning, will paste the summary here when ready.

Maya (People Ops): Action items recap: (1) publish master update Tue noon PT, (2) micro-cert for employees + manager checklist, (3) payroll CSV + mapping to Leo, (4) comp to post localized table, (5) legal done for EU contractor language. Any objections?

Priya (EMEA Ops): no objections.

Leo (Payroll): no objections, will confirm Friday.

Ana (Legal): good from legal side.

manager-bot: Publish triggered on Tue noon PT. Weekly compliance summary will post to #people-ops every Monday. :white_check_mark:

Maya (People Ops): thanks team — I'll post the prod link and the manager TL;DR once it's live.
